theorems.statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (W₀ B : Set (Euclid P)), R₁.Represents S₁ → R₂.Represents S₂ → IsOpen W₀ → IsOpen B → (S₁ - S₂).support ⊆ W₀ → W₀ ⊆ B → R₁.measure B + R₂.measure W₀ = R₂.measure B + R₁.measure W₀
